about.what: Ordinary least squares on NASA's FLEX table (PSI-69), one model per fuel and outcome. Nitrogen is the reference gas.

rate.label: Burning rate
rate.unit: as in NASA's column 'Burning rate; mm'
rate.note: How fast the droplet shrinks while it burns. Higher means faster burning.

about.fuel_left: Shown per test only: (extinction diameter / starting diameter) cubed, for tests NASA marks 'Extinction'.
about.limits: Fuel droplets only, inside the conditions FLEX tested. Not solid materials, not Moon gravity.
about.built_by: scripts/analyze_flex.py (written with AI assistance: Claude Code, Anthropic)
